fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, code, link, intent, sheet, use}], link, link_label, intent. sheet (optional): matrix, pid, spec or report (default from the name). use (optional): the qualification step the item's own text names as using it ("IQ"), shown as the stamp. Codes come from the DocList lookup (docCode).
best_for: IssuedSet shows the documents you receive as the issued set itself, dealt onto a desk: each document a sheet of paper at a slight turn with its code large, a miniature of what it looks like, its name and text, and a round stamp of the qualification step that uses it.

items.d: How the design meets each requirement; each gap with proposed wording.
Every line, valve and tag, with slopes, drains and sample points. IQ verifies against them.
Setpoints, alarms, interlocks and divert logic, each testable. OQ tests against them.

items.t: Design review report and traceability matrix
items.d: Evidence the design meets every URS line. Your quality unit approves DQ on it.
